name: Form Testing
description: Exercise fields, validation, and submit states in the shared Browser session without a destructive real-world submission.

permissionsRequired.reason: Open the page that contains the form.
Fill a field in the shared session.
Trigger validation or a safe submit.
Capture disabled, loading, error, and success states that appear.
See if submit produced a page error.

validation.rule: Field, validation, and submit behavior are described from browser_screenshot or the session result. No destructive real-world submission ran unless the user explicitly allowed it.
